channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Northern Lights Could Be Visible In Chicago This Week Before Bitter Cold Grips City
item.description: A geomagnetic storm watch has been issued for Tuesday. Plus, temperatures will turn “sharply” colder as the week progresses.

item.title: As Budget Stalemate Drags On, Some Warn Of Potential City Hall Shutdown
item.description: Dueling press conferences on Monday from Mayor Brandon Johnson and a group of alderpeople backing their own budget proposals yielded plenty of finger-pointing but few signs of a compromise.

item.title: How Chicago Protest Music Is Meeting The Political Moment
item.description: "Antifascist movements attract artists," one expert said. And Chicago has a long list of musicians who fit the bill, with a protest music history that goes back decades.

item.title: Chicago Friends’ ‘Rich Auntie Trivia’ Celebrates The Bougie Black Women Who Make Life More Fun
item.description: A new board game from four longtime friends honors the stylish enigmas who enrich our lives.

item.title: 3 Ways To Support Chicago’s Immigrant Arts Scene This Month
item.description: You can view the “Catalyst” exhibit at the Intuit Art Museum, see Teatro ZinZanni's new stage show and the hear the Chicago Immigrant Orchestra at Epiphany Center for the Arts.

item.title: Chicago Public Schools Finds Buyers For 3 Vacant Schools
item.description: The Chicago Board of Education is considering proposals to sell the former Bontemps, Henson and Shedd elementary schools for a collective $125,000. Two would be demolished for housing and one would become a community center.

item.title: Feds Threaten CTA Funding If Agency Doesn’t Add Cop Presence After Woman Set On Fire
item.description: The Federal Transit Administration is demanding the CTA implement a "verifiable security enhancement plan" by Dec. 19.

item.title: Immigration Raids Disrupt A Program Designed To Protect Chicago Schoolchildren
item.description: As Operation Midway Blitz spreads fear, some school safety workers — and students — are staying home.

item.title: Gov. Pritzker Signs Laws To Better Protect Immigrants, Sue Federal Agents After Midway Blitz
item.description: The new laws won't stop federal immigration enforcement, but they will give the state "new protective tools" and symbolize the state's resistance "against those terrorizing our communities and our state," Gov. JB Pritzker said.

item.title: DePaul Athletic Facility, Hundreds Of Apartments Across City OK’d By Council’s Zoning Committee
item.description: The City Council's zoning committee advanced the Lincoln Park practice facility, the Morgan Park Commons project and numerous apartment buildings on Tuesday.
